storyboard.spokenMeaning: You cannot stop others' opinions, but you decide how much of them reaches your life.
storyboard.viewerTakeaway: Opinions stay stacked outside my wall; the gap I set is the only thing that lets them in.
storyboard.visualMechanism: sluiceGapOnWall — opinion stack flush at a walled gap

visualNarrative.action: Left column holds the headline; beneath it six dim opinion rows stack flush against a vertical hairline wall, labeled PENDAPAT MEREKA.
visualNarrative.meaning: Others' opinions are a fixed mass that stays on their side — present, neutral, never erased.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Six equal dim rows end exactly at the center wall line; label PENDAPAT MEREKA sits above them, no row highlighted.

visualNarrative.action: A full-height hairline wall draws top-to-bottom down the center, leaving one small mid-height aperture; the right panel HIDUP LU fades in as a clean outline.
visualNarrative.meaning: The boundary of control is constructed, not given: life is a separate room with an opening you own.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Wall is one continuous 1px line with a single visible gap; right side shows only an outlined space labeled HIDUP LU.

visualNarrative.action: One thin teal thread leaves the stack, runs to the wall, passes through the aperture, and stops inside HIDUP LU.
visualNarrative.meaning: Influence still reaches you, but only as much as the opening allows — measured, not silenced.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Single teal hairline crosses the wall once; its width is clearly thinner than the stacked opinion rows.

visualNarrative.action: The aperture narrows to a slit while the thread thins and dims; the HIDUP LU outline holds crisp and brightens one step.
visualNarrative.meaning: You do not fight the source — you shrink the gap, so judgment carries less weight in your life.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Gap closes to a third; thread luminance drops; HIDUP LU outline stays unchanged and sharper.

visualNarrative.action: Headline words LU ATUR settle with a small scale emphasis, frame held static.
visualNarrative.meaning: The agency claim lands exactly as the gap finishes closing.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: LU ATUR scales from 1.03 to 1.0 in teal while everything else stays still.

motionBeats.purpose: Shows influence flowing only through the opening you allow.

motionBeats.action: Aperture narrows while thread thins and dims; HIDUP LU outline brightens a step.
motionBeats.purpose: The reframe: shrinking the gap, not fighting the source, is the control.

motionBeats.action: LU ATUR settles with a 1.03→1.0 subtleScale; frame static for the final half-second.

storyboard.compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject: headline and opinion stack anchored left (~8% margin), center a full-height hairline wall with one mid-height aperture, right an outlined HIDUP LU space crossed by a single thin teal thread. One accent (teal) only, glow absent or tiny behind HIDUP LU, ~65% negative space, caption on its own clear bottom band.
visualEvidence: Opinion rows end exactly flush against the wall — only one row continues as a thread.
Thread is visibly thinner than the rows and dims as the aperture narrows.
HIDUP LU stays empty and stable: life protected, opinions still present.
Subtitle band is fully clear of geometry and glow; headline fits within 4 lines.
forbiddenInterpretations: No gold or second accent anywhere — teal is the only accent, white for all other emphasis.
No dial, gauge, or rotating knob (repeat of the noise-dial mechanism).
No glow blob touching the caption; no lens flare, no particles.
Opinions never deleted, struck out, or shown in red — neutral dim rows only.
No empty unlabeled card: every panel carries its label.
No person silhouette, no converging arrows, no extra headline block.
storyboard.noveltyIntent: Control is staged as sluice-gap sizing on a physical wall — flow limited by aperture width — instead of the dial, spotlight, or grid devices used before.

subtitle.role: spoken line — kept clear of all glow and geometry, full width bottom
